cards.title: Hygiene basics
cards.text: Washing hands with soap prevents many infections such as diarrhoea and flu.

cards.title: Public health
cards.text: Public health protects whole communities through clean water, sanitation, vaccines and awareness.

cards.title: Sanitation
cards.text: Toilets and clean water stop disease spreading. Open defecation pollutes water.

cards.title: Vaccination
cards.text: Vaccines protect you and, by herd immunity, protect those who can’t be vaccinated.

cards.title: Epidemic vs pandemic
cards.text: An epidemic spreads in one region; a pandemic spreads across the world.

cards.title: Lessons from Covid
cards.text: The pandemic showed the value of hygiene, early action, science and community care.

qs.q: A lesson of the pandemic is…

cards.title: Dengue and malaria
cards.text: Mosquitoes spread dengue and malaria. Avoid stagnant water and use nets.

cards.title: Clean drinking water
cards.text: Boiled or filtered water prevents many stomach diseases.

cards.title: Food safety
cards.text: Wash food, cook it well and store it properly to avoid food poisoning.

cards.title: Prevention vs cure
cards.text: Prevention is cheaper and easier than treating disease.

cards.title: Air quality and health
cards.text: Polluted air leads to lung and heart disease, especially in children and elders.

cards.title: Health awareness
cards.text: Awareness drives and school education help people adopt healthy habits.

cards.title: Mental health
cards.text: Mental health is how we think, feel and cope. It matters as much as physical health.

cards.title: Stigma
cards.text: Stigma makes people hide mental illness. Talking openly and listening help.

cards.title: Stress and coping
cards.text: Exercise, sleep, hobbies and talking to someone you trust help manage stress.

qs.q: A healthy way to cope with stress is…

cards.title: Balanced diet
cards.text: A balanced diet has grains, protein, fruits, vegetables and enough water.

cards.title: Junk food
cards.text: Too much junk food causes obesity and diabetes. Enjoy it rarely.

qs.q: Junk food in excess leads to…

cards.title: Malnutrition
cards.text: Malnutrition means too little or poor food, leaving children weak and small.

cards.title: Sleep
cards.text: Teens need about 8 to 10 hours of sleep for memory, mood and growth.

cards.title: Exercise
cards.text: Regular activity strengthens heart, bones and mood.

cards.title: Substance abuse
cards.text: Tobacco, alcohol and drugs harm health and families. Say no and seek help early.

cards.title: Sedentary lifestyle
cards.text: Sitting too long raises the risk of heart disease. Move every hour.

cards.title: Yoga and meditation
cards.text: Yoga and breathing exercises improve flexibility and calm the mind.

cards.title: Body positivity
cards.text: Healthy bodies come in many shapes. Self-worth is not about looks.

cards.title: Healthcare access
cards.text: Many villagers live far from doctors. Health centres and mobile clinics bring care closer.

cards.title: Doctor shortage
cards.text: India has fewer doctors per person than recommended. Training more and retaining them matters.

qs.q: A solution to doctor shortage is…

cards.title: Telemedicine
cards.text: Telemedicine lets patients consult doctors by phone or video, helping remote areas.

cards.title: Health insurance
cards.text: Insurance protects families from huge medical bills.

cards.title: Cost of care
cards.text: Expensive treatment pushes families into poverty. Affordable care is a priority.

qs.q: Costly care can push families into…

cards.title: Generic medicines
cards.text: Generic medicines work like branded ones but cost far less.

cards.title: Medical technology
cards.text: MRI scans, robots and apps help diagnose and treat patients better.

cards.title: Equality in health
cards.text: Everyone deserves good care regardless of income, gender or place.

cards.title: Women’s health
cards.text: Women often neglect their health. Awareness and nutrition improve outcomes.

cards.title: Ageing
cards.text: As people live longer, elder care and health services become more important.

cards.title: Health workers
cards.text: ASHA and frontline workers bring health services to villages.

cards.title: Doctor-patient trust
cards.text: Honest talk and respect between doctors and patients lead to better care.
